desc: Derive the geometric visibility condition in terms of slopes and identify which endpoint(s) of buildings matter.
Reformulate the condition for building i as an inequality on observer height and derive its threshold value.
Implement exact O(N) maximization of adjacent rational thresholds `(H_{i-1}*X_i - H_i*X_{i-1}) / (X_i-X_{i-1})`, including the `-1` zero-visibility case.
Change final output conversion from Decimal to float fixed-point formatting and run all provided sample tests.
